unit: Program on Behavioral Economics and Public Policy (Harvard HLS)

labs.lab_name: Program on Behavioral Economics and Public Policy
labs.research_summary: Harvard Law School program on behavioral economics, law and public policy, with emphasis on behaviorally informed tools such as default rules, norms and simplification.
labs.notes: The page names no director, staff, contact, address or phone. It lists seven participating Harvard faculty (Cass Sunstein, Iris Bohnet, David Laibson, Adrian Vermeule, Max Bazerman, Sendhil Mullainathan, Oren Bar-Gil) and Sunstein's profile is linked (https://hls.harvard.edu/faculty/cass-r-sunstein/), but the page does not say he leads the program, so pi_name is null and no count is given. The worklist people page (HLS staff dashboard) and careers page (HLS career planning) are university-wide, not program pages, and were not used.

notes: Only the program page itself was relevant; no lead, count or join page shown.
